digest.component_or_area: review-kernel cross-gate cutover guard and canary
propositions: A deterministic shadow comparator must verify that both defaulted gate paths use one shared policy authority, make no duplicate shadow calls, and preserve narrow outputs, without issuing model calls or controlling final verdict.

Cross-gate fixture tests must prove approved deltas (effective built-in retune/disable, project DET inclusion, project LLM applicability, positive code-review budget enforcement, typed partial-failure continuation, success-only checkpointing) are applied correctly across all failure modes.

Repository-policy guards must prevent a review gate from bypassing CriteriaSnapshot to read packaged/project routing directly, introducing a second discovery scheduler outside the shared kernel, or adding per-unit trace fields to review/review-status schemas.

A live canary at tests/external/test_review_discovery_live.py must drive the real default plan-review and code-review discovery paths through the external LLM provider matrix, assert narrow final verdict (PASS/BLOCK) with coverage.llm_ran=True and sidecar_emitted=True, and print no secrets or prompt/context bodies.

New code must ignore legacy checkpoint envelopes; the retained compatibility projection cannot write new envelopes or decide a final verdict; revert to the legacy projection requires no journal rewrite or data cleanup.
docs/review-kernel.md must document final snapshot/executor/gate/RP-01 ownership, approved deltas, sensitive-data boundary, shadow behavior, and revert-based rollback strategy.
